annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, complete Algorithm 4.1 execution certificate, and finite componentwise formalization of Theorem 4.4

assumptions: The dimensions n, b, and q are positive and n=q*b, so A and its computed factors are square n-by-n matrices partitioned into b-by-b blocks.
A successful finite-real execution of Algorithm 4.1 produces the computed unit lower-triangular factor LHat and nonsingular upper-triangular factor UHat.
The precision parameters uLow, uBar, uFma, and uWork are nonnegative, uBar<=uFma, and every gamma expression used in Theorems 4.3 and 4.4 satisfies its strict validity condition.
The computed factors satisfy LHat*UHat=A+factorError and the factorError obeys Theorem 4.3's exact componentwise cFact*(|A|+|LHat||UHat|) bound.
Forward and backward substitution produce yHat and xHat with (LHat+deltaL)yHat=rhs and (UHat+deltaU)xHat=yHat.
The triangular-solve perturbations satisfy |deltaL|<=gamma(uWork,n)|LHat| and |deltaU|<=gamma(uWork,n)|UHat| componentwise.
All represented quantities are finite reals; underflow, overflow, exceptional IEEE values, and the double-rounding effect omitted by the paper are outside the model.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p04_t3_block_lu_solve_backward_error {n b q : ℕ} (run : P04BlockLUSolveRun n b q) : ∃ deltaA, p04MatVec (run.A+deltaA) run.xHat = run.rhs ∧ ∀ i j, |deltaA i j| ≤ (p04FactorizationCoeff run.uLow run.uBar run.uFma run.uWork q n b + 2*gamma run.uWork n + (gamma run.uWork n)^2) * p04LUSolveScale run.A run.LHat run.UHat i j
formal_statement.plain_language: For every certified Algorithm 4.1 factorization followed by forward and backward substitution, construct the single nearby matrix from Theorem 4.4 and prove equation (4.7) with the exact factorization coefficient, both linear solve terms, the quadratic solve term, and the mandatory |A|+|LHat||UHat| scale.

informal_proof: Define deltaA=factorError+LHat*deltaU+deltaL*UHat+deltaL*deltaU. Expand (LHat+deltaL)(UHat+deltaU), replace LHat*UHat by A+factorError, and use matrix-vector associativity with the two substitution equations. Bound the three solve terms by gamma_n|LHat||UHat|, gamma_n|LHat||UHat|, and gamma_n^2|LHat||UHat|, enlarge them to the required |A|+|LHat||UHat| scale, and add the factorization bound.
informal_statement: The complete nearby-system equation and componentwise bound of Theorem 4.4 and equation (4.7) for a successful block-FMA LU solve.
